approach: Add one prose paragraph to the change producer prompt (crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/producer.md), as its own paragraph before the closing "Before you report" step. It gives the producer what the four failed jobs lacked. For an intermittent or racy failure, the producer reproduces it on the base tree under parallel load with a test that loops the action on threads and counts failures, before and after the fix. The text says shell loops are denied and points at crates/athena-testkit/tests/stand_in_stress.rs as the working example. The producer names the cause in code terms and fixes it where it starts. If several sites share the pattern, it fixes them once in one shared helper and adds a repo test that finds every site, and shows that test fails with the cause put back. The paragraph is about 418 bytes. A unit test in crates/athena-cap-change/src/lib.rs pins each element inside that paragraph, pins the report step as the last paragraph, and checks that the named example file exists. The larger prompt moves the computed producer set size, so one number in docs/system-facts.md changes, because the budget drift test requires it. CHANGELOG.md gets one entry and docs/decisions.md gets D189. D189 and the changelog name the planner brief as a stage that also lacked this guidance and propose a follow-up. No refusal rule, gate or job step is added: 0% of past accepted readings are refused. The testkit helper, the scan, the stress test and the drain.rs fix from the earlier jobs are already in the tree and are not touched.

decisions.choice: Give the producer the missing guidance in the change capability's own producer section, as prose pinned by a unit test. State the loop-test method, keep 'fix it where it starts' unconditional, and make the shared helper and the all-sites scan conditional on the pattern being at several sites.
decisions.reason: The failing stage lacked information: nothing in its brief said how to reproduce a flake under load, how to name the cause, or how to fix a repeated pattern once. The request prefers giving information over a refusal rule. The section is compiled in by include_str! at crates/athena-cap-change/src/lib.rs:21 and returned by Change.producer_section() (lib.rs:51). The existing test module at lib.rs:118 is where its test goes. Finding 2 (critic, major): the producer's Bash policy splits at && ; | and newlines and requires each program on the role's list (crates/athena-agent/src/policy.rs:6-10). athena.toml:84 gives the change producer only cargo, git, ls, rm, mv and chmod, so a for or seq loop is refused. The paragraph therefore says to loop inside one test on several threads and count failures, as crates/athena-testkit/tests/stand_in_stress.rs does (WRITERS=4, CYCLES=200, FORKERS=4, a failure count; lines 13-15, 20-68), and says shell loops are denied. A pinned phrase covers 'loops the action on threads and counts failures', 'shell loops are denied' and 'stand_in_stress.rs'. Finding 4 (critic, minor): the 9daz flake in crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs was a single-site race, so a mandatory helper and scan would over-generalise. The text reads 'fix it where it starts' with no condition, and 'If several sites share it, fix it in one shared helper and add a repo test that finds every site'.

rejected.why: It is a gate that holds or rejects work and needs core changes. The brief puts it out of scope, and the information gap is closed by the brief.

The new and moved lines are not list items, so the prompt-structure rule sees nothing: it judges only added lines holding a base item head or a glued item (crates/athena-core/src/mirrors.rs:514-541), and the base file has no list item. The base size of 1043 tokens means 3127 to 3129 bytes. The addition is 418 plus 3 = 421 bytes, which gives an estimated 1183 or 1184 tokens (an estimate), about 16 below 1200. A 470-byte cap would land on exactly 1200 and protect nothing. Which capability is the largest producer set: the study section is about 1090 bytes by my count of crates/athena-cap-study/prompts/producer.md, against 1096 for the change section, so the two are close. The reader brief's room figure of 157 for the change file equals 1200 minus 1043, so the change set is the current maximum. After the addition the change set is certainly the maximum, whichever was larger before. The earlier plan's figure of about 900 bytes for the study section was wrong and is dropped.

decisions.reason: Finding 1 (athena, minor): the file is not a listed deliverable. The edit is forced by code. The producer row is the maximum over capabilities (crates/athena-cli/tests/budgets.rs:42-61), and the facts file is compiled into the planner and critic briefs (crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs:1524). system_facts_budgets_match_computed (budgets.rs:125-129, message at :109-114 'update docs/system-facts.md') and system_facts_drift_is_rejected (:132) fail the recorded cargo test --locked check otherwise. Precedent: commit d94ebc2 changed this producer file and the facts file together (HISTORY.txt:582-588). That needs a criterion that change_limit matches (briefs.rs:186-276). I read all six accepted criteria against the forms 'no file outside X changed', 'no other file changed', 'only X may change', 'test-only change' and 'production unchanged'. 'states only what the diff does' has no 'may change' within six words, and 'does not touch' is not a form, so none matches and there is no send-back. The plan finding is Minor (crates/athena-core/src/admission.rs:306-312). The verifier can run cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets to see the edit is required. dependents.reason: Not changed in this diff: the brief's out-of-scope list holds the shared prompts as they are, and the planner frame is its own budget set. D189 and the CHANGELOG.md entry name it as the follow-up (one sentence in the planner frame, about 95 tokens of room).

demonstrations.method: Read the diff of the prompt file against the base and check each required element is in one new paragraph. Then read the root-cause statement in the CHANGELOG.md and docs/decisions.md diffs.
demonstrations.observes: The diff splits the old line 3 at 'study-claim-support.md).' and adds one paragraph between its two halves. The new paragraph, about 418 bytes, contains these elements. 'For an intermittent or racy failure, reproduce it on the base tree under parallel load with a test that loops the action on threads and counts failures before and after the fix (like stand_in_stress.rs; shell loops are denied).' 'Name the cause in code terms; fix it where it starts.' 'If several sites share it, fix it in one shared helper and add a repo test that finds every site; show it fails with the cause put back.' The old sentences are unchanged, and the 'Before you report, reread the brief's criteria_check section...' sentence is now the last paragraph. No line starts with '- ', '* ' or a number marker. The root cause is named in the CHANGELOG.md and docs/decisions.md diffs: the producer brief had no guidance for a flaky or racy test (an information gap), failure class flaky-test-fix-patches-call-sites-not-root-cause, and the planner brief is named as a follow-up.

demonstrations.method: Add the test the_producer_brief_carries_the_flaky_test_guidance to the existing tests module (lib.rs:118) and run the crate's tests. The test reads Change.producer_section().text and splits it at blank lines. It finds the paragraph that starts 'For an intermittent or racy failure'. It asserts, inside that paragraph and each with its own message, the phrases 'on the base tree under parallel load', 'loops the action on threads and counts failures before and after the fix', 'stand_in_stress.rs', 'shell loops are denied', 'in code terms', 'fix it where it starts', 'in one shared helper', 'finds every site' and 'fails with the cause put back'. It asserts that exactly one paragraph follows it and that this paragraph starts 'Before you report, reread the brief's criteria_check section'. It asserts that Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("../athena-testkit/tests/stand_in_stress.rs") is a file.
demonstrations.observes: With the change, every test in the crate passes: build_output_is_refused, grants_come_from_the_configuration and the new test. On the base tree the new test fails on its first assertion because producer.md holds none of the guidance.
demonstrations.fails_without: Delete or reword the new paragraph in crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/producer.md, or merge it back into the report paragraph, and the test fails. On the base tree the producer prompt has two paragraphs after its heading and none starts with 'For an intermittent or racy failure', so the first expect fails with 'the flaky-test guidance is a paragraph of its own'. Deleting one phrase makes the matching assertion fail with its own message. Renaming crates/athena-testkit/tests/stand_in_stress.rs makes the path assertion fail. The producer runs this mutation check once before reporting.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry point: Change.producer_section() (crates/athena-cap-change/src/lib.rs:51), the Capability trait method that returns PRODUCER_SECTION, whose text is include_str!("../prompts/producer.md") (lib.rs:18-22). Guard: Capability is in scope through the module's use super::*. No fake or fixture: the real compiled asset is read, so the phrases are the pinned contract, and the stress-test path is read from the real workspace. Precondition: none. The function and the tests module exist today; plan step 2 adds only the test function.

demonstrations.method: Run the budget tests, which recompute each role set as ceil(bytes/3) over contract, frame and each capability's producer section (budgets.rs:21-61), and compare with the facts file. Also run cargo test -p athena-context, which compares the compiled prompt text with the file on disk (crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs:445-456) and checks no section mentions agent-reference (:815-820). The recorded Athena test check (cargo test --locked, athena.toml:106-109) runs the same tests on the final tree.
demonstrations.observes: system_facts_budgets_match_computed, system_facts_drift_is_rejected, every_role_set_is_within_its_budget, an_over_budget_role_set_fails and the_reader_headroom_rows_equal_the_budget_figures_and_name_shared_files pass. The facts file reads '  - budget producer: <N> of 1200' with N equal to the computed value. By my byte count N is 1183 or 1184 (an estimate; the exact value is read from the test's failure message after the prompt edit, not guessed), below the 1200 budget. The planner, critic, verifier, reader and contract lines are unchanged.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the edit to the '- budget producer:' line of docs/system-facts.md, system_facts_budgets_match_computed fails with 'producer: the facts file says 1043 of 1200, the computed value is <new> of 1200; update docs/system-facts.md'. If the paragraph were large enough to push the set over 1200, check_budget returns Err and every_role_set_is_within_its_budget fails at its unwrap (budgets.rs:371).
demonstrations.seam: Production entry points: athena_cli::wiring::capabilities() and athena_context::check_budget, driven by crates/athena-cli/tests/budgets.rs:21-61 and :125-129. The input is the real docs/system-facts.md through athena_context::briefs::SYSTEM_FACTS (crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs:1524). No double. Exists; this plan changes no test code in budgets.rs.

demonstrations.method: Athena records three checks for the change capability from athena.toml: fmt (cargo fmt --all --check, :93-97), clippy (cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings, :99-102) and test (cargo test --locked, :106-109). The verifier reads the three recorded results on the final tree and also runs cargo test --locked, cargo fmt --all --check and cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings itself. The skip_when_only rule (docs/ and *.md) does not skip fmt or clippy here, because the diff touches crates/athena-cap-change/src/lib.rs.
demonstrations.observes: All three checks pass: the test run ends with no failed test, including the new unit test, the budget tests, the context headroom tests, the mirrors tests over the prompt file and decision log, the testkit scan crates/athena-testkit/tests/no_in_process_exec_writes.rs, the refusal_corpus tests that read CHANGELOG.md and the xtask policy tests. fmt prints no diff and clippy prints no warning.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the producer-line number update, cargo test --locked fails at system_facts_budgets_match_computed. Without the paragraph, the new unit test fails. With an unformatted new test, cargo fmt --all --check fails; with an unused import or a needless borrow, cargo clippy -D warnings fails.

It says what the diff does (the paragraph, the test, the facts-file number, D189), says the helper, scan, stress test and drain.rs fix are already in the tree and untouched, names the planner follow-up, and says 0% of past accepted readings are refused.
